observation.command:
sleep 40; cd /workspace/deployment
TOKEN=$(curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -X POST https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/ -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"username":"admin","password":"Admin!LocalDev123"}' | tr -d '\n' | sed 's/.*"access":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
echo "token len: ${#TOKEN}"
echo "=== QGIS WMS GetCapabilities (authenticated) ==="
curl -sk --resolve qgis.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://qgis.localhost/ows/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities" -o /tmp/qgis_caps.xml -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"
head -c 500 /tmp/qgis_caps.xml; echo
